mapper.select: SELECT community_id AS "postNum", community_title AS "title", community_content AS "content", community_category AS "category", community_nickname AS "author" FROM ( SELECT community_id, community_title, community_content, community_category, community_nickname, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY community_id DESC) AS row_num FROM community_section ) WHERE row_num BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY row_num

SELECT community_id AS "postNum", community_title AS "title", community_content AS "content", community_category AS "category", community_nickname AS "author" FROM ( SELECT community_id, community_title, community_content, community_category, community_nickname, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY community_id DESC) AS row_num FROM community_section WHERE member_num = #{memberNum} ) WHERE row_num BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY row_num
